component.name: Dogi
component.summary: 在 Linux 上配置 Logitech 鼠标

description.p: Dogi is a Linux desktop application for configuring Logitech mice, with direct HID++ access and local runtime actions.
Dogi 是一款用于配置 Logitech 鼠标的 Linux 桌面应用，支持直接访问 HID++ 设备以及本地运行时操作。

ul.li: Manage independent settings for multiple devices
Configure scrolling, pointer speed, buttons, and application profiles
Review explicit device changes before applying them

description.p: Improves device discovery, desktop integration, and the configuration experience.
